name: Kubari Donzaburo
source:
The protagonist’s homeroom teacher. Nicknamed ‘Teacher Donzabu’ by the students. For some reason, he can’t talk to people without Don-chan, a stuffed animal he carries around. Has a surprisingly amiable personality. He’s the advisor of the handicrafts club and is good at sewing, but he always puts his students first, so he’s quite bad at looking after himself.

‘Ah…Um…I’m so sorry…Forgive me…’
‘Despite all this…I just want to stay as your teacher.’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
